svg.aria-label: Of a €100 gross dividend from an Austrian company, the bank withholds €27.50 KESt (27.5%) and pays €72.50 to you
svg.title: Of a €100 gross dividend from an Austrian company, the bank withholds €27.50 KESt (27.5%) and pays €72.50 to you
svg.text: A €100 dividend from an Austrian company
The bank pays the KESt to the tax office for you. For this dividend, nothing more needs to be declared.
Interest on bank deposits is taxed at 25%; most other capital income at 27.5%.
